These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

> **Note:** These settings live on the display CPU but are stored and saved by the main processor. They configure the built-in LED show - the show itself runs from the Light Show panel.

## Default Show

The LED show the display boots into

**How to use it** — press `c`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## LED Strips Enabled

How many external LED strips the built-in show drives

**How to use it** — press `s`.

**What you enter** — `value`.

## Roku LED Control

Allow a Roku remote to cycle LED show patterns

**How to use it** — press `i`.
